comment: UI icons imported from PokeAPI/sprites (CC0 repository; LICENCE states all image contents are © The Pokémon Company). Types: HGSS type badges (generation-iv/heartgold-soulsilver, ids 1-17; Fairy did not exist in Gen IV and uses an original badge). Items: DS-era bag icons, each mapped to a game effect that matches the item's canonical effect (docs/ICONS.md).
